title: Unicode rain (#13) may not fully realize all-CSS approach (Hue-rings fallback)
description: Unicode rain (#13) shipped with a 'Hue rings' fallback because the original all-CSS approach 'doesn't look good.' Revisit whether the intended Unicode-rain effect can be achieved, or formally accept the fallback as the final design.

title: Crystals showcase (#11) shipped with reduced scope (2 shapes, intended 4)
description: The Crystals piece (#11) fell back to a 2-shape variation instead of the intended 4-shape variety. Documented inline as a limitation in the seed-context plan. Revisit to restore the fuller 4-shape design if feasible within the all-CSS constraints.
close_reason: Replaced the positional 2-triangle fallback with a parametric gem facet: all four polygon vertices driven by seeded --rand-N values (count bumped 2->5), so every cell is a distinct crystal (verified 100/100 unique clip-paths). Exceeds the original 4-shape intent and is genuinely random per cell (old version was positional nth-child, not random). All-CSS, no @property needed. Verified pixel-consistent across Chromium/Firefox/WebKit; 36/36 component tests pass. Files: docs/styles.css, docs/showcase.html.

title: Add direct test for seed-context prng getter
description: The `prng` getter on <seed-context> (src/seed-context.js:40) returns a fresh seeded mulberry32 instance per access, but no test verifies it directly — it's only exercised indirectly through showcase tiles. Add a unit/Playwright test asserting it returns a deterministic, seed-derived sequence.
